summary: OVNI persona round 5 fixer: Geoscape, base, campaign, menus, dialogs and accessibility options

fix.api:
OV.Dom:
- tooltip() now remembers which node it is showing a hint for. The first pointer move after that node leaves the DOM, or stops being hovered, hides the hint.
- modal() hides the hint and the long-press label as it opens.
- New: OV.Dom.tooltipNode() returns the node whose hint is on screen, or null.

OV.Scenes: push, pop, replace and set all call OV.Dom.hideTooltip() and OV.Dom.hideLongPress() before changing scene.

OV.CampaignUI:
- leftAtBase(G, craft, pool, {night}?) and leftAtBaseAll(G, craft, pool, {night}?) return [{id, n, ab}], where ab is how many are already aboard.
  - A type that is already aboard is still listed when the base holds more of it than goes aboard.
  - It is also listed when there are fewer grenades, medikits or flares aboard than soldiers.
  - At night, flares come right after capture gear.
  - An ammo type that is not aboard, for a weapon that is aboard, comes right after the weapons. Plain surplus of types already aboard goes last.
- leftText(G, craft, pool, base, {night}?) writes «12 × Sinalizador (4 a bordo)».
- fieldKitPlan(G, craftId, {night}) returns {loadouts, stores, armed, med, flares, carriers, want} and does not change G. The plan takes nothing away from anyone and stays within each soldier's Strength:
  - soldiers who carry only a pistol get a free infantry rifle;
  - if nobody carries a medikit and one is available, it goes into someone's pack;
  - at night, up to 3 soldiers get a flare on the belt.
- fieldKit(G, craftId, {night}) returns {ok, armed, med, flares, reason?} and applies the plan through Campaign.applyEquip.
- fieldKitText(r) returns the summary text for a fieldKit result.
- landedHurt(G, siteRef) returns true when a landed UFO has dmg > 0.
- Internally, upgradePlan(G, craftId, {fromPistol:true}) handles the pistol-only case.

Briefing:
- New warning id 'kit', with one button for all kit warnings: «Completar o kit», or «Equipar para a noite» at night. Key K.
- At night the flare warning comes first.
- New warnings: cp.br.warn.flaresAboard(.none/.one/.other), cp.br.warn.pistols, cp.br.warn.medAboard.
- Notes: cp.br.note.landedDamaged for a damaged landed UFO; cp.br.note.leaves replaces the «esperar pelo dia» note when the UFO will leave before dawn.

Equipar scene: a footer button with the same label (K) appears when the plan has something to do. It applies the plan and rebuilds the screen.

OV.GeoUI.model:
- nightAt() now also returns leaves: true during the learning months when the landed UFO will take off before dawn.
- waitIsDefault() returns false for any landed UFO without nt.safe, in every difficulty.
- New: groundTransport(G, craft) is true for a transport with no weapons or with soldiers aboard.
- New toastFor types: 'transportHome' and 'crewBoarded'.

Geoscape scene behaviour:
- When ufoLiftOff or landedUfoGone arrives, any transport heading for that UFO (status out or patrol) is recalled with World.recall and a toast says why.
- craftReturned and soldierRecovered call crewUp on transports in the hangar with free seats, which boards fit soldiers who have no craft.
- The «Alvo perdido» popup for a transport has «Regressar à base» as the default button (Enter), with «Patrulhar» on P.
- Each «Próximos passos» item is a button.geo-step with data-step, a tooltip and an action:
  - research opens Base › Investigação with pick;
  - hire opens Pessoal;
  - speed sets the speed to «30 min»;
  - ufo speeds up time and shows a radar hint toast.
- «Vender material» calls openBase(baseId, 'market', {market:'sell'}).

OV.BaseUI:
- open(G, baseId, tab, {market:'buy'|'sell'}) also works when the base is already on top (sc.go(baseId, tab, opts)).
- Every btn with class 'seg' now gets aria-pressed automatically, from its 'on' class.
- The armour and seat groups have role=group and an aria-label.
- CSS shows a ✓ before .seg.on.

OV.DogfightUI.model.ufoLabel(G, ufo) uses GeoUI.model.typeKnown. When the type is known it shows «OVNI-3 · Batedor Grande (médio)» (new key df.ufoKnown).

CSS:
- In the cvd palette, --hp is now #e6eef5 (it was the same blue as --tu).
- In portrait or narrow base layouts, base toasts move to the bottom of the screen.
- .geo-step styles include hover, focus-visible and a 32 px touch target.

New i18n keys:
- geo.ev.arrived.night.leaves, geo.ev.arrived.dusk.leaves
- geo.ev.targetLost.transport
- geo.toast.transportHome(.many)
- geo.steps.{research,hire,speed,ufo}.tip, geo.steps.done, geo.steps.ufo.hint
- cp.eq.leftAboard
- cp.br.kit(.tip), cp.br.kit.night(.tip)
- cp.kit.armed.one/.other, cp.kit.med, cp.kit.flares.one/.other, cp.kit.none
- cp.br.note.landedDamaged, cp.br.note.leaves
- df.ufoKnown
fix.summary:
I fixed all 14 round-5 findings for the strategy/shell side and skipped none. For 3 of them, part of the fix belongs in files other agents own; those exact patches are in open_issues.

**Results**
- Node suite `tools/test.js --strict --i18n`: 835 passed, 0 failed (final run). Earlier runs had failures only in tests owned by the battle and sim fixers (campaign_pacing, sim_persona, ui_persona, integration_r4 explosion), which were mid-edit at the time.
- New `tools/tests/shell_persona_r5.test.js`: 13 tests, one or more per finding.
- New `qa/persona_r5_shell.mjs`: 71/71 checks, with screenshots at 1440×900, 1024×576, and iPad 834×1194 / 1194×834 with touch.
- Other QA scripts:
  - persona_r4_shell: 72/72; persona_r3_shell: 113/113; persona_r3_casual: 64 checks, 0 failures.
  - geo_check: 36/36; base_ui_check: 90/90; campaign_flow_check: 127 checks, 0 failures.
  - dogfight_check: one timing check («Esc minimiza», 150 ms wait) failed on the first run while the CPU was shared; the rerun passed 44/44.
  - full_campaign failed once, then passed: «campanha completa sem erros». The battle fixer's new end-of-battle panel («Durante o turno alienígena» with «Continuar para o relatório») sits in front of the mission report, so I made full_campaign.mjs click that button.
- I looked at screenshots of every screen I changed: night briefing, Equipar, Geoscape steps, night arrival popup, «Alvo perdido», Mercado › Vender, soldier sheet, and base toasts in portrait.

**Per finding**
- **#0 / #8 (stale tooltip over the next screen): fixed at the root.**
  - Every scene change hides the tooltip and the long-press label (in `OV.Scenes`).
  - A tooltip whose button has been removed from the page, or is no longer under the pointer, disappears on the next mouse move.
  - Opening a modal also hides any tooltip.
  - Regression: Node test of the scenes module in isolation, plus QA (hover COMPRAR, press Esc, the tooltip is gone).
- **#1 («Ficaram em …» ignored types already aboard): fixed.**
  - Types already aboard are now listed with the count, e.g. «12 × Sinalizador (4 a bordo)», when the base holds more or when there are fewer grenades, medikits or flares aboard than soldiers.
  - At night, flares come right after capture gear.
  - A missing ammo type, such as Heavy Cannon HE, is listed even when the weapon is aboard; plain surplus goes to the end.
  - Regression: Node test and QA.
- **#2 (Wait for daylight was the default and the UFO left): fixed.**
  - For a landed UFO, waiting is the default (Enter) only when the game knows the UFO stays until dawn, in every difficulty.
  - In the learning months, when the UFO will take off first, the popup and the briefing say so: «Este OVNI vai levantar voo antes de amanhecer: se esperar, perde a missão.»
  - This reverses earlier tests that said «Recruta: sempre esperar»; I updated them (see deviations).
- **#3 (VENDER MATERIAL opened Buy): fixed.** `BaseUI.open` now accepts a market mode, including when the base screen is already open. The button opens Vender. Regression: Node test and QA.
- **#4 (no flares and pistols at night): fixed on the strategy side.**
  - The briefing shows a «Equipar para a noite» button at night («Completar o kit» by day), key K. Equipar has the same button in its footer.
  - It puts a flare on the belt of up to 3 soldiers, gives a free rifle to anyone with only a pistol, and puts an unused medikit in someone's pack.
  - It never takes anything from anyone and stays within each soldier's Strength.
  - The medikit being taken away comes from the per-soldier AUTO-EQUIPAR in inventory_ui, which I don't own: patch in open_issues.
- **#5 (unarmed transport chased the UFO; PATRULHAR was the default): fixed in the UI.**
  - When a UFO takes off, transports heading for it go home through `World.recall`, with a toast explaining why.
  - «Alvo perdido» for a transport has «Regressar à base» as the default, plus a line that a transport cannot intercept.
  - The proper sim-side fix is in open_issues.
- **#6 (Próximos passos looked like links but did nothing): fixed.** Each step is now a button with a tooltip and keyboard focus. Research opens the base's Investigação and hire opens Pessoal; the speed step sets the clock to «30 min», and the UFO step speeds up time and explains the radar.
- **#7 (fit soldiers left at base after casualties): fixed at the root.**
  - When a craft returns to the hangar, or a soldier recovers, fit soldiers without a craft board the transport if there are free seats, with a toast.
  - The send-team dialog now flags «Lugares vazios» as a warning rather than info.
- **#9 (dogfight header showed only the radar echo): fixed.** The header uses the same «type known» rule as the Geoscape and shows «Batedor Grande (médio)» once identified.
- **#10 (briefing said «casco intacto» after damage): fixed with the text option.** The note now says the UFO landed damaged and that the damage does not make the assault easier, because in the code it really has no effect.
- **#11 (soldier sheet choices had no accessible state): fixed at the root.** Every segmented button in the base gets `aria-pressed` automatically; the Armadura and Nave groups are named; the chosen option shows a ✓.
- **#12 (base toasts over the tabs in portrait): fixed.** In portrait or narrow layouts the toasts go to the bottom of the screen. QA confirms the toast no longer overlaps the tabs at 834×1194.
- **#13 (health and TU bars the same blue in the colour-blind palette): fixed in my part.** Health is now white-grey (#e6eef5) in that palette. The bleeding marker and spoken label on the squad row are in battle_ui: patch in open_issues.
deviations:
I updated four older tests whose expectations conflict with the round-5 decision or with renamed code, keeping the change minimal:
- tools/tests/shell_persona_r3.test.js: the «Recruta: sempre esperar» cases now pass nt.safe explicitly, and I added the case where the UFO may leave (attack is the default). I also relaxed the regex on the leftAtBase call so it accepts the new {night} argument.
- tools/tests/casual_persona_r3.test.js: the same safe / not-safe split.
- tools/tests/integration_r3.test.js: the regex for how the night text key is built now also accepts nightSuffix(nt).
- tools/tests/late_persona_r4.test.js: the regex accepts openBase(…, {market:'sell'}).

Finding #5: the sim was not changed. The transport goes home through the UI, which calls World.recall when the UFO it was heading for takes off, and that only runs while the Geoscape is open. The headless bot does not get this; the sim patch for that is in open_issues.

Finding #4: instead of applying the night kit automatically and silently (which would override loadouts a veteran set up on purpose), there is a one-tap «Equipar para a noite» / «Completar o kit» button (key K) in the briefing warnings and in the Equipar footer. The per-soldier «AUTO-EQUIPAR TODOS» button lives in inventory_ui, which I don't own; the K button covers the same need.

Finding #7: soldiers are boarded automatically when a craft returns to the hangar or a soldier recovers. This also re-boards soldiers a player deliberately took off the craft, the next time it returns. The same already happens when new hires arrive.
qa/full_campaign.mjs now clicks the battle fixer's new «Continuar para o relatório» panel when it appears before the mission report.
open_issues:
Battle fixer (js/ui/battle_ui.js, finding #13, my part done in css/base.css): on the squad row, add a bleeding marker and extend the spoken label.
- Where the row's aria-label is built from hud.sq.aria (about l.2242), append T('hud.sq.bleeding') when (u.wounds || []).some((w) => w > 0).
- Next to the bars (about l.2258), add el('span', { class: 'bs-sq-bleed', 'aria-hidden': 'true', text: '✚' }) when the soldier is bleeding.
- New pt-PT.hud key: 'hud.sq.bleeding': ', ferido a sangrar'.
- CSS: .bs-sq-bleed { position: absolute; right: 6px; top: 4px; color: var(--red); font-weight: 900; }

Equipment UI owner (js/ui/inventory_ui.js, finding #4): AUTO-EQUIPAR takes the medikit away from whoever had it. In autoFor(s), before emptyInto(s.id), compute const hadMed = loTypes(E.loadouts[s.id]).indexOf('medikit') >= 0 and pass { keepMed: hadMed } into autoLoadout's options. In autoLoadout, change the medikit condition from (best && best.id === s.id && have('medikit') …) to ((opt.keepMed || (best && best.id === s.id)) && have('medikit') …). The soldier's own medikit goes back to stores in emptyInto, so it is available again.

Sim owner (js/sim/geo/missions.js onUfoLiftOff or js/sim/geo/world.js, finding #5): so the headless bot also stops chasing, after ufo.status = 'flying' in onUfoLiftOff, add a loop over G.crafts. For each craft c with c.dest && c.dest.kind === 'ufo' && c.dest.id === ufo.id, D().crafts[c.type].transport, (c.status === 'out' || c.status === 'patrol') and !c.dogfightId, call OV.World.recall(G, c.id), or set c.dest = 'home' and status 'returning' the same way recall does. The UI's transportsHome() then finds nothing left to do, so the two do not conflict.
Not mine: when my last full suite ran, all 69 files were green. The campaign_pacing2 and sim_persona_r5 tests owned by the sim fixer had failed in an earlier run while they were editing them.
